entities.summary: Glen H. Taylor was a performers & entertainers in Portland (1904-04-12, Portland – 1984-04-28) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
